title: Plans — round 11: the one-line pause and the pause headings

steps.path: A plan paused because its progress couldn't be saved
steps.headline: That pause is now one line: the message on the left, Report bug, Ask the assistant, Stop and Continue on the right.
steps.changed: The separate warning block and the Add budget button are gone, and the card's heading now reads "paused — something went wrong".
steps.notice: One clear message and the buttons that can actually help.

steps.path: The heading at the top of a paused plan card
steps.headline: Do these headings for a paused plan read right?
steps.today: The heading at the top of a paused plan used to say "paused — reached its limit" for almost every pause, even ones that had nothing to do with the limit.
steps.problem: A wrong heading makes you look for the wrong fix.
steps.proposal: The heading now follows the reason: "paused — reached its limit" (out of budget), "paused — needs a revised plan" (repeated steps never met their goal), "paused — a specialist was stopped" (you stopped one), "paused — something went wrong" (errors), and just "paused" for older plans. Yes keeps these; Other lets you reword any of them.
